up: Retrieve the first 200 metabolism records where the organism is Macaca fascicularis. For each record, include the substrate name, parent compound name, SMILES of the substrate, conversion details, pathway information, and enzyme name. Join the metabolism table with compound records to get the names and structures. Ensure the organism filter is applied correctly to the metabolism table.
sql:
SELECT
  sub.compound_name AS substrate_name,
  drug.compound_name AS parent_compound_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles AS substrate_smiles,
  m.met_conversion AS conversion_details,
  m.pathway_key AS pathway,
  m.enzyme_name AS enzyme_name
FROM metabolism m
JOIN compound_records sub ON m.substrate_record_id = sub.record_id
JOIN compound_records drug ON m.drug_record_id = drug.record_id
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON sub.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE m.organism = 'Macaca fascicularis'
LIMIT 200
